response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong alignment with the Staff Software Engineer role, particularly in distributed systems, AI-driven development, and technical strategy. His recent work at re:cinq (AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators) and experience with high-throughput systems at Dunnhumby media directly match the role's core requirements. While his background is diverse, the depth in relevant domains and operational ownership mindset make him a compelling candidate.
strengths: Direct experience with AI-driven engineering (re:cinq's agentic workflows and code generators)
Proven expertise in high-throughput distributed systems (Dunnhumby media's micro-services handling millions of requests/sec)
Strong operational ownership (on-call readiness, CI/CD, and infrastructure maintenance at multiple roles)
concerns: Limited explicit mention of stakeholder management at scale (cross-functional coordination beyond engineering)
No clear evidence of participation in formal agile ceremonies (e.g., scrum champion rotation)
Diverse technical background may dilute focus on Python/TypeScript (though recent roles emphasize these)
